definitions.MACD: EMA12(close)-EMA26(close), signal EMA9(MACD); each EMA SMA-seeded at its first complete period
definitions.ADX: Wilder14 true range and mutually exclusive positive/negative directional movement; ADX SMA-seeded first14 valid DX, then Wilder recursion
definitions.ASDTSRockwellTrading: enter MACD>0 and MACD>signal; exit MACD<signal
definitions.AwesomeMacd: enter MACD>0 and AO>0 with previous AO<0; exit MACD<0 and AO<0 with previous AO>0
definitions.CofiBitStrategy: enter candle open<EMA5(low), K crosses above D (previous K<=D), K<25 and D<25 and ADX14>25; exit candle open>=EMA5(high) or K crosses above75 or D crosses above75
